routes.title: Light Lab: Interactive Optics Simulations for Physics
routes.description: Free interactive optics for high-school physics: reflection, refraction, Snell's law, total internal reflection, prism dispersion, mirrors and lenses.

routes.title: Refraction and Snell's Law Simulator | Light Lab
routes.description: Drag a light ray between air, water, glass and diamond and watch Snell's law bend it, with live angles, speeds and n1 sin i = n2 sin r worked out.

routes.title: Total Internal Reflection and Critical Angle | Light Lab
routes.description: Push the angle past the critical angle and watch the refracted ray vanish. Live critical angle, reflected percentage and an optical fibre demo.

routes.title: Prism Dispersion Simulator: White Light Spectrum | Light Lab
routes.description: Split white light into a spectrum with a glass prism. Change the glass, apex angle and wavelength, find minimum deviation, and see rainbows form.

routes.title: Concave and Convex Mirror Ray Diagrams | Light Lab
routes.description: Drag the object in front of a concave or convex mirror and watch the ray diagram, image position, magnification and mirror formula update live.

routes.title: Convex and Concave Lens Ray Diagrams | Light Lab
routes.description: Move an object in front of a convex or concave lens and see the image form, with the lens formula, magnification and power in dioptres worked out.
